tools.name: add_contact_tag
tools.title: Add Contact Tag
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Give a contact one or more tags by name, keeping the tags it has; a tag the account lacks is made.

tools.name: add_contact_to_circle
tools.title: Add Contact to Circle
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add a client or prospect to a circle; they gain its portal access and are emailed its shared files.

tools.name: add_staff_to_team
tools.title: Add Staff to Team
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add one colleague to a team, by the ids find_team and find_colleague give. They gain what the team can reach.

tools.name: add_subtask
tools.title: Add Subtask
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add a subtask (a checklist step) under a task named by its title or id; it goes to that task's assignee.

tools.name: add_time_entry
tools.title: Add Time Entry
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add a stretch to a timer, finished or billed too; start and end are required, and a running timer is refused.

tools.name: adjust_client_balance
tools.title: Adjust Client Balance
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Top up, take away from or set a client's prepaid balance (credit, hours, sessions), by the id read_client_balance gives.

tools.name: apply_auto_template
tools.title: Apply Auto-Template to Record
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Apply the Auto-Template an Auto-Decision Skill chose to a contact or company, only once the person has said yes.

tools.name: apply_project_template
tools.title: Apply Task Template to Project
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Apply one of the account's task templates to a project, dated from a chosen day.

tools.name: archive_project
tools.title: Archive Project
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Archive a project off the Projects list; restore_project brings it back.

tools.name: archive_work_request
tools.title: Archive Work Request
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Archive a client's work request, moving it off the Work Requests list; restore_work_request brings it back.

tools.name: bill_expense
tools.title: Bill Expense
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Bill an unbilled expense to its client on a new draft invoice, never sent; it marks the expense Invoiced.

tools.name: bill_task
tools.title: Bill Task
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Bill a task onto a new or draft invoice or accumulating generator as a $0.00 line; takes no amount or due date.

tools.name: bill_timer
tools.title: Bill Timer
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Bill the stretches preview_timer_billing priced, its priced value repeated; bills nothing if anything changed.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel Subscription
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Cancel a subscription for good: it can email the client, fire the webhook and end paid and course access.

tools.name: claim_contact
tools.title: Claim Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Claim for the salesperson asking a contact or company nobody holds, as Claim on the CRM screen does.

tools.name: close_deal
tools.title: Close Deal
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Close a deal as won or lost, marking the sale won or the opportunity lost.

tools.name: comment_on_task
tools.title: Comment on Task
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Post a comment on a task, named by its title or id; its assignee and followers are told.

tools.name: convert_contact
tools.title: Convert Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Move a lead to prospect or client, or a prospect to client, as Convert on the CRM screen does; it gets a portal login.

tools.name: convert_work_request_to_estimate
tools.title: Convert Work Request to Estimate
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Convert a work request into a new or existing estimate or quote; items become lines and the client is emailed.

tools.name: convert_work_request_to_invoice
tools.title: Convert Work Request to Invoice
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Convert a work request into a new or existing invoice; items become lines and the client is emailed a link.

tools.name: convert_work_request_to_project
tools.title: Convert Work Request to Project
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Convert a work request into a new or existing project; items become tasks and the client is emailed a link.

tools.name: create_circle
tools.title: Create Circle
tools.description: Create a circle with a name, an optional description and an optional color. It starts with no members.

tools.name: create_company
tools.title: Create Company
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add a company to the CRM, only when the person asks to add one. Needs an existing contact to represent it.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.title: Create Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add a person to the CRM, at an existing company when the person names one.

tools.name: create_deal
tools.title: Create Deal
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add a new sales deal (opportunity) for a contact in a pipeline: its value, expected close and stage.

tools.name: create_estimate
tools.title: Create Draft Estimate
tools.description: Draft an estimate: a quote, not a bill. It is never sent.

tools.name: create_expense
tools.title: Create Expense
tools.description: Record a one-time business expense (a cost or receipt): what it was, its amount and date, a client to bill it to.

tools.name: create_follow_up
tools.title: Create Follow-Up
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Set a follow-up with a contact, as Add Follow-Up does; on their calendar, it can email them.

tools.name: create_invoice_draft
tools.title: Create Draft Invoice
tools.description: Draft an invoice for a client. It is never sent; a person decides that.

tools.name: create_item
tools.title: Create Item
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add a one-time item to the account's catalog, offered by every invoice and estimate picker. Only when asked.

tools.name: create_note
tools.title: Create Note
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Leave a note on a contact, a company or a project.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create Project
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Start a project for a client. Dates are written the way this account writes them.

tools.name: create_proposal
tools.title: Create Draft Proposal
tools.description: Draft a proposal: a document of pages, not a bill. It is never sent.

tools.name: create_staff_member
tools.title: Create Staff Member
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Add a colleague to this account. Cannot make anyone an administrator.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create Task
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Raise a task for someone in this account. It makes a task of its own, never a subtask of another.

tools.name: create_team
tools.title: Create Team
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Create a team with a name, an optional description and optional members (user ids from find_colleague).

tools.name: delete_circle
tools.title: Delete Circle
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a circle for good; its members lose its portal access.

tools.name: delete_company
tools.title: Delete or Deactivate Company
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Set an active company inactive, or delete an inactive or idle one for good, as its CRM list does for the person asking.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.title: Deactivate Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Set a contact inactive, as Set Inactive on the CRM screen does for the person asking; their portal login closes too.

tools.name: delete_deal
tools.title: Delete Deal
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a deal for good; it leaves the pipeline board and the Deals list.

tools.name: delete_estimate
tools.title: Delete Draft Estimate
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a draft estimate as the estimate list's Delete lets the person asking. One already sent or approved stays.

tools.name: delete_expense
tools.title: Delete Expense
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete an expense for good; one already billed on an invoice is never deleted.

tools.name: delete_follow_up
tools.title: Delete Follow-Up
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a follow-up for good; it leaves its calendars.

tools.name: delete_invoice_draft
tools.title: Delete Draft Invoice
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a draft invoice as the invoice list's Delete lets the person asking. Anything already sent or paid stays.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.title: Delete Note
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a note as the note screen lets the person asking; a note that came from a support ticket stays.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.title: Delete Project
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a project as the person asking could on the project screen. Its tasks, files and phases are retired with it.

tools.name: delete_proposal
tools.title: Delete Draft Proposal
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a draft proposal as the proposal list's Delete lets the person asking. One already sent or signed stays.

tools.name: delete_staff_member
tools.title: Deactivate Staff Member
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Remove a colleague as the staff screen's Set Inactive does: the login closes, the record stays and can be restored.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.title: Delete Task
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a task, as the person asking could on the task screen. Its files and subtasks go with it.

tools.name: delete_team
tools.title: Delete Team
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a team as the Teams list's Delete does: it leaves the list and its team chat channel is removed.

tools.name: delete_time_entry
tools.title: Delete Time Entry
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete one stretch of a timer by its id from read_timer; one running or on an invoice is refused.

tools.name: delete_timer
tools.title: Delete Timer
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Delete a timer by its title or id; one with any invoiced time is refused.

tools.name: duplicate_project
tools.title: Duplicate Project
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Start a copy of a project with its tasks and team; it is made in the background.

tools.name: find_circle
tools.title: Find Circles
tools.description: Find or list circles by name, oldest or newest first, as the Circles list shows them. Use before a circle id.

tools.name: find_colleague
tools.title: Find Staff Members
tools.description: Find or list colleagues by name or email, oldest or newest first, as the staff roster shows them. Use before a user id.

tools.name: find_company
tools.title: Find Companies
tools.description: Find or list companies by name, oldest or newest first, as the company list shows them. Use before a company id.

tools.name: find_contact
tools.title: Find Contacts
tools.description: Find or list contacts by name, email or role, oldest or newest first, as the contact list shows them. Use before an id.

tools.name: find_deal
tools.title: Find Deals
tools.description: Find or list deals by title, contact, pipeline, stage, category, close date, amount, oldest or newest first.

tools.name: find_estimate
tools.title: Find Estimates
tools.description: Find or list estimates by title, number or client, oldest or newest first, as the person sees them. Use before an id.

tools.name: find_expense
tools.title: Find Expenses
tools.description: Find or list business expenses (costs, receipts) by title, client, status, date or total, oldest or newest first.

tools.name: find_follow_up
tools.title: Find Follow-Ups
tools.description: Find or list follow-ups by status, category, contact, host, due dates or name, or oldest or newest first.

tools.name: find_invoice
tools.title: Find Invoices
tools.description: Find or list invoices by title, number or client, oldest or newest first, as the person sees them. Use before an id.

tools.name: find_item
tools.title: Find Items
tools.description: Find or list catalog items by name, oldest or newest first, as the invoice and estimate line picker offers them.

tools.name: find_note
tools.title: Find Notes
tools.description: Find or list notes by title on a contact, company or project, or on every one, oldest or newest first, as tabs show.

tools.name: find_payment
tools.title: Find Payments
tools.description: Find or list payments received on invoices and subscriptions by payer, method, day, transaction id or when recorded.

tools.name: find_project
tools.title: Find Projects
tools.description: Find or list projects by name, oldest or newest first, on the Projects list of the person asking. Use before its id.

tools.name: find_proposal
tools.title: Find Proposals
tools.description: Find or list proposals by title or client, oldest or newest first, as the person sees them. Use before a proposal id.

tools.name: find_sales_room
tools.title: Find Sales Rooms
tools.description: Find or list prospects' Sales Rooms (private links to a sales page design) by contact, design, status, oldest or newest.

tools.name: find_subscription
tools.title: Find Subscriptions
tools.description: Find or list clients' recurring subscriptions by number, client, plan or status, oldest or newest first.

tools.name: find_task
tools.title: Find Tasks
tools.description: Find or list tasks by title, oldest or newest first, among those the person sees on their task lists. Use before its id.

tools.name: find_team
tools.title: Find Teams
tools.description: Find or list teams by name, oldest or newest first, as the Teams list shows them. Use before anything needing a team id.

tools.name: find_timer
tools.title: Find Timers
tools.description: Find time-tracking timers by title, client, project, task, status, billing or owner, or oldest or newest first.

tools.name: find_work_request
tools.title: Find Work Requests
tools.description: Find clients' work requests by name, client, status or day they came in, newest or oldest first: what awaits triage.

tools.name: finish_timer
tools.title: Complete Timer
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Mark a paused timer Completed by its title or id; one running, already completed or with no recorded time is refused.

tools.name: generate_sales_room
tools.title: Generate Sales Room for Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Generate a contact's own Sales Room from a design and, as the design says, email them its private link.

tools.name: link_contact_to_company
tools.title: Link Contact to Company
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Link a contact in no company to a company, as Add Contact on its page does; it can email them the circle's files.

tools.name: link_text_number_to_contact
tools.title: Link Text Number to Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Link an unknown number's text conversations to a contact, as Link to Contact in the text inbox does.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.title: List Skills
tools.description: Lists the published Skills available to the signed-in staff member, including their IDs, names, kinds and summaries.

tools.name: log_time
tools.title: Log Time
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Log a past time entry, with start and end, on a task or project as a new paused timer, at the person's own rate.

tools.name: make_expense_recurring
tools.title: Convert Expense to Recurring
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Turn a one-time expense into a recurring expense on a schedule: a recurring copy, left as a draft.

tools.name: move_deal
tools.title: Move Deal
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Move a deal to another stage of its pipeline, which runs that stage's automations.

tools.name: pause_timer
tools.title: Pause Timer
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Pause a running timer by its title or id; its running stretch ends now.

tools.name: preview_timer_billing
tools.title: Preview Timer Billing
tools.description: Price billing a timer's time before bill_timer: what it would charge, or why it is refused; bills nothing.

tools.name: reactivate_sales_room
tools.title: Activate Revoked Sales Room
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Reactivate a revoked Sales Room so the prospect's same link works again.

tools.name: read_circle
tools.title: Get Circle Details
tools.description: Read one circle: its description, color, whether it is on, and the clients and prospects in it.

tools.name: read_client_balance
tools.title: Get Client Balances
tools.description: See a client's prepaid balance: credit, prepaid hours, prepaid sessions left. Give the client's name or id.

tools.name: read_colleague
tools.title: Get Staff Member Details
tools.description: Read one colleague's record (role, email, last visit, Custom Fields) as the staff roster shows them to the person.

tools.name: read_company
tools.title: Get Company Details
tools.description: Read one company in full, custom fields included, as the person asking could open it.

tools.name: read_contact
tools.title: Get Contact Details
tools.description: Read one contact in full (custom fields, company and the companies it represents) as the person asking could open it.

tools.name: read_deal
tools.title: Get Deal Details
tools.description: Read one deal: how likely it is, amount, pipeline stage, won or lost, close date, contact, who follows it, history.

tools.name: read_deal_activity
tools.title: Read Deal Activity
tools.description: Read the latest activity on deals the person follows: moves, wins, losses and changes, newest first.

tools.name: read_deal_forecast
tools.title: Read Deal Forecast
tools.description: Read a pipeline forecast by month: open, weighted, won and expected sales revenue to close.

tools.name: read_estimate
tools.title: Get Estimate Details
tools.description: Read one estimate: lines, totals, paid, balance due, notes and Custom Fields, when the person's estimate list shows it.

tools.name: read_expense
tools.title: Get Expense Details
tools.description: Read one expense: its cost lines, total, billed or unbilled status, client, receipt date, recurring schedule.

tools.name: read_follow_up
tools.title: Get Follow-Up Details
tools.description: Read one follow-up: contact, host, when, category, status, who sees it, whose calendars it is on.

tools.name: read_invoice
tools.title: Get Invoice Details
tools.description: Read one invoice: lines, totals, paid, balance due, notes and Custom Fields, when the person's invoice list shows it.

tools.name: read_item
tools.title: Get Item Details
tools.description: Read one catalog item (rate, quantity, discount, tax, descriptions, pricing options) as the Items screen shows it.

tools.name: read_note
tools.title: Get Note Details
tools.description: Read one note (message, author, the record it is on) as the person asking would see it on its notes tab.

tools.name: read_payment
tools.title: Get Payment Details
tools.description: Read one payment: its amount, method, day, status, payer, the invoice it paid and its transaction id.

tools.name: read_project
tools.title: Get Project Details
tools.description: Read one project as the person asking could open it: open tasks, Custom Fields, and who its tasks can be assigned to.

tools.name: read_proposal
tools.title: Get Proposal Details
tools.description: Read one proposal (status, value, valid until, recipients, pages, reminders) when the person sees it on the list.

tools.name: read_sales_room
tools.title: Get Sales Room Details
tools.description: Read one Sales Room: its prospect, design, active or revoked status, private link, when they last opened it.

tools.name: read_subscription
tools.title: Get Subscription Details
tools.description: Read one client's subscription: what it bills, how often, its next bill date, status, tax and discount.

tools.name: read_task
tools.title: Get Task Details
tools.description: Read one task in full, its project and assignee included, when the person asking sees it on one of their task lists.

tools.name: read_team
tools.title: Get Team Details
tools.description: Read one team (its description and the colleagues on it) as the Teams page shows it to the person asking.

tools.name: read_timer
tools.title: Get Timer Details
tools.description: Read one timer: its tracked time, time entries with start and end, rate, billed and unbilled money, and what it is for.

tools.name: read_work_request
tools.title: Get Work Request Details
tools.description: Read one client's work request: what was asked, its items, answers, messages, price and what it converted to.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.title: Record Payment
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Record money received on an invoice: it can email the client a receipt, run paid automations and grant access.

tools.name: remove_branding_template
tools.title: Remove Branding Template
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Take the applied Branding Template off the portal, leaving a clean look with its logos and the old look as a backup.

tools.name: remove_contact_from_circle
tools.title: Remove Contact from Circle
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Take a person out of a circle; they lose its portal access.

tools.name: remove_contact_tag
tools.title: Remove Contact Tag
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Take one tag off a contact by its name, as read_contact lists it; the contact's other tags stay.

tools.name: reopen_deal
tools.title: Reopen Deal
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Reopen a won or lost deal, so it is open again in its stage.

tools.name: repoint_timer
tools.title: Move Timer to Other Work
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Point a timer at a different task, project or client, or at nothing; its time moves too and it keeps running.

tools.name: restore_contact
tools.title: Restore Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Bring back an inactive contact (find_contact with inactive true), as Set Active does; they rejoin their marketing lists.

tools.name: restore_project
tools.title: Restore Archived Project
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Bring an archived project back onto the Projects list.

tools.name: restore_time_entry
tools.title: Restore Deleted Time Entry
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Put back a stretch deleted from a timer within the last ten minutes, by the id it had.

tools.name: restore_timer
tools.title: Restore Deleted Timer
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Bring a deleted timer back onto the Timers page by its title or id, with its time entries.

tools.name: restore_work_request
tools.title: Restore Archived Work Request
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Bring an archived work request back to the Work Requests list, in the status it held.

tools.name: resume_timer
tools.title: Resume Timer
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Run a paused or completed timer again by its title or id; running a completed one clears its Completed.

tools.name: revoke_sales_room
tools.title: Revoke Sales Room
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Revoke a prospect's Sales Room link so it stops working; it can be reactivated later.

tools.name: run_ar_aging_report
tools.title: Run Accounts Receivable Aging
tools.description: Run Accounts Receivable Aging: what clients owe on unpaid invoices, by days overdue (0-30 to 91+) or by client.

tools.name: run_email_campaign_performance_report
tools.title: Run Email Campaign Performance
tools.description: Run Email Campaign Performance: sends, opens, clicks and unsubscribes, by campaign, month, audience or link.

tools.name: run_invoice_status_report
tools.title: Run Invoice Status Summary
tools.description: Run Invoice Status Summary: the invoices of a period counted and totaled by status, by month or by client.

tools.name: run_on_time_completion_report
tools.title: Run On-time Completion
tools.description: Run On-time Completion: tasks finished on time or late in a period, by project, assignee, client, leader or month.

tools.name: run_overdue_tasks_report
tools.title: Run Overdue Tasks
tools.description: Run Overdue Tasks: tasks past their due date and how late, by project, assignee, client, project leader or status.

tools.name: run_payments_received_report
tools.title: Run Payments Received
tools.description: Run Payments Received: payments taken in a period, by day, week, month, client, method, gateway or status, or each one.

tools.name: run_profit_and_loss_report
tools.title: Run Profit & Loss
tools.description: Run Profit & Loss: income, refunds, expenses, tax and net profit in a period, by month, direction or category.

tools.name: run_project_health_report
tools.title: Run Project Health
tools.description: Run Project Health: projects on track, at risk or overdue and their progress, by project leader, client or status.

tools.name: run_revenue_overview_report
tools.title: Run Revenue Overview
tools.description: Run Revenue Overview: invoiced, collected and outstanding revenue by month, quarter, year, invoice status or client.

tools.name: run_sales_by_target_report
tools.title: Run Sales by Target
tools.description: Run Sales by Target: what each client was invoiced in a period, by client, month or owner, or invoice by invoice.

tools.name: run_sales_pipeline_report
tools.title: Run Sales Pipeline
tools.description: Run Sales Pipeline: the deals of a pipeline, their value and weighted value, by stage, client or expected close month.

tools.name: run_sales_tax_report
tools.title: Run Sales Tax
tools.description: Run Sales Tax: the tax collected, refunded and net on payments in a period, by tax or by month.

tools.name: run_timesheets_report
tools.title: Run Timesheets
tools.description: Run Timesheets: the time logged in a period, entry by entry or by day, week, month, staff, client, project or task.

tools.name: run_uninvoiced_time_report
tools.title: Run Uninvoiced Time and Value
tools.description: Run Uninvoiced Time and Value: billable time not yet invoiced and its value, by client, project, staff, task or date.

tools.name: send_portal_invite
tools.title: Send Portal Invitation
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Email a prospect or client their portal invitation, until accepted. Not after convert_contact emailed it.

tools.name: set_circle_status
tools.title: Set Circle Status
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Switch a circle on or off; off takes its portal access from its members.

tools.name: set_company_primary_contact
tools.title: Set Company Primary Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Make a contact the primary contact who may act for a company, as its page does; it can email them that they now do.

tools.name: set_contact_salespeople
tools.title: Set Contact Salespeople
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Set a contact's primary salesperson and the salespeople it is shared with, or unassign it, as the contact page does.

tools.name: set_follow_up_status
tools.title: Set Follow-Up Status
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Mark a follow-up done, which runs its automations, or not done.

tools.name: set_project_status
tools.title: Set Project Status
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Set a project's status to one of the account's own; Completed finishes it.

tools.name: set_task_priority
tools.title: Set Task Priority
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Set a task's priority (urgent, high, normal, low or the account's own) by its title or id.

tools.name: set_timer_day
tools.title: Set What a Day Comes To
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Set what one day of a timer comes to, in hours; below its billed time, or while it runs that day, is refused.

annotations.title: Set What a Day Comes To

tools.name: start_timer
tools.title: Start Timer
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Start a running timer now in the person's own name at their own rate (takes no rate), beside any already running.

tools.name: unlink_contact_from_company
tools.title: Unlink Contact from Company
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Unlink a contact from their company, as Remove on its contact list does; they leave the company's circle.

tools.name: update_circle
tools.title: Update Circle
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a circle's name, description or color (only the fields you name); members change through their own tools.

tools.name: update_company
tools.title: Update Company
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a company's details, its Custom Fields included. Only the fields you name are touched.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.title: Update Contact
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a contact's details, company and Custom Fields included. Only the fields you name are touched; role is not one.

tools.name: update_deal
tools.title: Update Deal
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Edit a deal's details (title, value, expected close, contact, followers); only the fields you name.

tools.name: update_estimate
tools.title: Update Draft Estimate
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a draft estimate's title, due date, amount, client Note or Custom Fields, as the person's estimate screen allows.

tools.name: update_expense
tools.title: Update Expense
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Edit an expense's details (title, amount, date, client, billable, category); only the fields you name.

tools.name: update_follow_up
tools.title: Update Follow-Up
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change or reschedule a follow-up to another day or time, only the fields you name; its calendars follow.

tools.name: update_invoice_draft
tools.title: Update Draft Invoice
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a draft invoice's title, due date, amount, client Note or Custom Fields, as the person's invoice screen allows.

tools.name: update_note
tools.title: Update Note
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a note's message or title, as the note screen lets the person asking. Who can see it is not touched.

tools.name: update_project
tools.title: Update Project
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a project's details, its Custom Fields included. Only the fields you name are touched; the client is not one.

tools.name: update_proposal
tools.title: Update Draft Proposal
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a draft proposal's title or due date, as the proposal editor lets the person asking. Its pages are not touched.

tools.name: update_staff_member
tools.title: Update Staff Member
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a colleague's details, their Custom Fields included. Only the fields you name; the role is not one.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.title: Update Subscription
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a subscription's quantity, rate, discount, tax, next bill date or billing cycle; never its client or plan.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update Task
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Complete a task, hand it to someone else, or move its due date.

tools.name: update_team
tools.title: Update Team
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Change a team's name or description. Only the fields you name; members are added with add_staff_to_team.

tools.name: update_time_entry
tools.title: Update Time Entry
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Correct one stretch of a timer by its id from read_timer; one running or on an invoice is refused.

tools.name: update_timer
tools.title: Update Timer
tools.description: Asks the person to confirm in the app before it acts. Rename a timer, or change its hourly rate or note; a new rate reprices its tracked time.

tools.name: use_skill
tools.title: Use a Skill
tools.description: Retrieves a published Skill by ID, including its saved instructions and related settings.
